decisions.reason: The protection cap costs almost nothing to keep in the accessory range, and the missing website evidence for 2020 to 2021 is not enough to justify abandoning such a cheap option, though it raises the risk of withdrawal.

Box trailers are core volume products that share production with the established range, so the option stays open despite the lack of recent visibility, given that a sister series was already pruned in 2019.
Car transporters serve a professional niche whose demand is still uncertain, but shared components keep holding costs low enough to wait for clearer results.
Low-bed trailers are a core category that was featured prominently and costs little at the margin, so there is no strong signal for abandonment.
High covers build cheaply on existing trailer platforms and preserve upside, so keeping them remains sensible despite the unobserved recent years.
